mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with deutetrabenazine (vesicular monoamine transporter 2 inhibitor) increases central monoamine concentrations, creating risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and CNS toxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, baseline/monitoring of blood pressure, and patient education on hypertensive crisis symptoms.
